l-not-connect contract as the directory install. Pass `expectedUpdatedAt` from `listRegistryServers` to freeze the card.\n- [Unins

ge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/send-one-agent-playground-message.md): Send one message to a project's MCP

turn execution spans: per-tool-call latency, token usage, and indices into the transcript. Same span shape as the eval iteration t
race.\n- [Open the API session browser](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/open-the-api-session-browser.md): Same
